name: Rapid7 InsightVM
summary: InsightVM scans sites of assets, scores each asset with a risk score and tracks fixes in remediation projects that can sync with Jira and ServiceNow. Rapid7 now sells it inside Exposure Command and publishes no prices.

facts.text: InsightVM is now part of Rapid7's Exposure Command. Essentials combines InsightVM with attack surface management, and Ultimate adds cloud and application security.
Rapid7's documentation says each asset's detail view shows a calculated risk score, and tags can raise the score of critical assets.
Remediation projects track solutions through the statuses Open, Awaiting Verification, Will Not Fix, Closed and Reopen, and project metrics update as vulnerabilities stop appearing in scans.
Remediation projects can integrate with Jira and ServiceNow, and solution statuses update from the ticketing system.
Rapid7's Exposure Command pricing page lists no prices and sends buyers to a demo request. It says billable asset usage is tracked against the customer's entitlement.

plans.name: Exposure Command Essentials (includes InsightVM)
plans.notes: No prices on the pricing page. Request a demo

hiddenCosts: No public price. The pricing page mentions volume discounts above 1,000 assets without giving the terms.
